description: CGS Information Warehouse: Landslide Maps and Reports is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Conservation. Since the 1960's, the California Geological Survey (CGS) has produced numerous maps that show landslide features and delineate potential slope-stability problem areas. Preparation of these maps has been episodic, often driven by landslide disasters and subsequent legislative mandates. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Conservation. Its tags are CAOpenData, CGS, California, California Department of Conservation, California Geological Survey. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
